response.rationale: Both forms denote a police officer. Indonesian commonly uses “polisi,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses the more explicit “pegawai polis”; the contrast is useful, though “polis” is also an ordinary Malaysian alternative.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian learners may commonly encounter “polis” instead of “pegawai polis,” especially in informal usage.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Malaysian “polis” can also ordinarily refer to a police officer, but “pegawai polis” remains a useful explicit/formal preference; this does not invalidate the Indonesian–Malaysian contrast.
